context: Tests whether the agent includes the optional Non-goals and Reversibility sections in an ADR when the decision context makes them appropriate. The task describes a narrowly scoped decision with explicit exclusions and a potentially reversible architectural change — both conditions the skill says should trigger these optional sections. Also verifies standard ADR structural requirements.

checklist.name: Non-goals section present
checklist.description: The ADR includes a Non-goals section (or equivalent heading such as 'Out of Scope')

checklist.name: Non-goals lists specific exclusions
checklist.description: The Non-goals section lists at least one specific type of notification or communication channel that is explicitly excluded (e.g., marketing emails, SMS, push notifications, weekly digests, or the marketing team's flows)

checklist.name: Reversibility section present
checklist.description: The ADR includes a Reversibility section (or equivalent heading such as 'Rollback' or 'Reconsideration')

checklist.name: Reversibility describes reconsideration conditions
checklist.description: The Reversibility section names at least one specific condition that would trigger reconsideration or a rollback (e.g., delivery failure rates above a threshold, queue system instability, latency regression, SLA breach)

checklist.name: Status PROPOSED
checklist.description: The ADR has status: PROPOSED in its YAML frontmatter (not ACCEPTED or DECIDED)

checklist.name: Authors field present
checklist.description: The ADR has an authors field in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.name: Decision in active voice
checklist.description: The Decision section begins with 'We will' or an equivalent first-person plural active construction (not passive voice)

checklist.name: At least two alternatives listed
checklist.description: The Alternatives Considered section contains at least two distinct options

checklist.name: Alternatives have pros, cons, rejection reasons
checklist.description: Each alternative includes explicit pros, cons, and a reason it was not chosen

checklist.name: Consequences split into three subsections
checklist.description: The Consequences section is divided into Positive, Negative, and Neutral subsections — all three present with content

checklist.name: No placeholder text
checklist.description: The ADR does not contain unfilled template markers such as '[Driver 1]', '[Alternative 1]', 'TBD', or similar placeholder strings
